settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust your settings in every area — easily and efficiently.
settings.themeDesc: Light, dark, or follow your operating system
settings.langDesc: The language the interface is shown in. buno always replies in the language you write to it.
settings.timeRoundDesc: How time logged on tasks is shown
settings.timeRoundNote: Work is measured as value, not minutes — so the default rounds up to a full hour.
settings.capacityDesc: Above 80% of the day — buno notes the day is packed
